annotations.title: Which listed sports businesses are growing, making money and spending to acquire customers?

description: Use when the user is an investor, deal team or league business office comparing sports companies: "is DraftKings growing faster than Flutter?", "which sportsbook spends most on marketing?", "who has the best margins among team owners?". Returns, for each company's latest fiscal year from its 10-K as filed: revenue, revenue growth, operating margin, sales and marketing and advertising as a share of revenue, the group medians and the filing behind each row. Covers DKNG, FLUT, CHDN, PENN, RSI, MSGK, BATRA, TKO, LYV, SPHR, MSGE. Refuses before you are charged if a filer's name does not match the company. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: latest fiscal year, with growth on the year before; compare: group or tickers (2-8); segment: metric (in the result). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For one company against hand-picked peers on a single metric, use run_peer_benchmark; for college programs, use run_college_athletics.

group.description: A preset group: betting (DKNG, FLUT, CHDN, PENN, RSI), teams (MSGK, BATRA, TKO) or live (LYV, SPHR, MSGE). Give a group or tickers.

tickers.description: Or 2-8 tickers, comma-separated, from: DKNG, FLUT, CHDN, PENN, RSI, MSGK, BATRA, TKO, LYV, SPHR, MSGE.
